description: FreightFA Invoice Audit: compare what a shipper was billed (or quoted) for a truckload or LTL load against today's market benchmark for the same lane. Use this whenever the user uploads, attaches, pastes, or describes a freight invoice, carrier or broker bill, rate confirmation, or BOL (PDF, image, photo, screenshot, or spreadsheet) and asks to audit it or check whether the price is fair. Read the fields off the uploaded document yourself in chat and call this tool with only those extracted fields — never pass the raw document, its text, company or people's names, street addresses, or invoice, PRO, BOL, or account numbers. If a document lists multiple separate loads, call this tool once per load. If the document doesn't say what kind of truck moved a truckload shipment, ask the user. Dry Van and LTL return a verdict (above_market, at_market, good_price, below_floor) against FreightFA's market quote, negotiation target, and walk-away floor, plus what negotiating would have saved. Reefer and Flatbed return FreightFA's estimate and the gap with no verdict (no_call). The comparison is all-in with fuel (linehaul + fuel surcharge); pass the invoice grand total in billed_total and put detention, lumper, liftgate, layover, or other extras in accessorials so they are excluded from the benchmark comparison. Bills older than 90 days are not judged. Takes places, not miles. Each call counts as one estimate toward the account's monthly FreightFA allowance.

accessorials.description: Optional. The part of billed_total that is extras (detention, lumper, liftgate, residential, layover, stop-off), in dollars. Omit or pass 0/null when none.

billed_total.description: Invoice grand total (linehaul + fuel + accessorials) in U.S. dollars.

destination.description: Delivery / ship-to / consignee location: city and state, or ZIP.

freight_class.description: LTL only (optional): NMFC freight class from the invoice such as '70' or '92.5', or omit/null.

mode.description: Equipment or service type. Map standard truckload/FTL/53' van to 'Dry Van', refrigerated/temp-controlled to 'Reefer', flatbed/step-deck to 'Flatbed', and less-than-truckload to 'LTL'.

origin.description: Pickup / ship-from location: city and state, or ZIP (e.g. 'Chicago, IL 60601'). Never use the bill-to, remit-to, or broker address.

pallets.description: LTL only (optional): pallet count, or omit/null.

ship_date.description: Optional. Ship or pickup date as YYYY-MM-DD. Omit or pass null if the invoice only shows an invoice date or no date.

weight_lbs.description: LTL only (required for LTL, omit or null for truckload): shipment weight in pounds.

name: check_freight_bill
title: Audit a freight invoice against the market
